title: The New Adventures of Nero Wolfe
paragraphs: Sydney Greenstreet stars as brilliant, eccentric detective Nero Wolfe, who prefers solving cases from his New York brownstone while his assistant Archie Goodwin handles much of the outside legwork.

NBC detective series starring Sydney Greenstreet as Nero Wolfe. Twenty-six programs were broadcast and 25 survive in the frozen set; program #4, The Case of the Headless Hunter (1950-11-10), is the lone missing program.
The run breaks into several distinct periods: Sydney Greenstreet NBC run (October 20, 1950 to April 27, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Don Stanley (announcer), Edwin Fadiman (producer and executive producer), J. Donald Wilson (director and producer), [[person|sydney-greenstreet|Sydney Greenstreet]] (performer), Rex Stout (creator and author), William Johnstone (performer), and Harry Bartell (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]] and [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]].
The stories often return to armchair detection and delegated legwork, murder investigation, detective partnership and legman narration, and literary characters adapted to original radio cases.
